title: Merge JSON without prototype pollution
summary: Deep-merge untrusted JSON into defaults while refusing keys that would change Object.prototype.
prompt:
Finish `safeMerge(target, source)`. It deep-merges plain objects from `source` into a **new** object based on `target` and returns it; neither input is changed.

- Plain objects merge recursively. Arrays and other values from `source` replace what is in `target`.
- Skip the keys `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` at every level, so `JSON.parse('{"__proto__":{"admin":true}}')` cannot give every object an `admin` property.
- Only copy own enumerable keys.
hints: A plain object here is `value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)`.
Loop over `Object.keys(source)` and `continue` on the blocked names.
